Thanks for helping grow the standalone examples. See the [example contribution guide](https://github.com/shivamnegi92/awesome-entity-extraction/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#add-or-improve-a-runnable-example). You can also skip this issue and open a PR directly.

## Use case

What real extraction task should the example demonstrate? Who would use it?

## Proposed approach

Which catalog tool/model/API should it use? What makes this different from an existing example?

## Input and expected output

Use only synthetic or public, redistributable sample data. What should a successful run show?

## Setup and trade-offs

Mention expected dependencies, model downloads, credentials/cost, hardware, and limitations if known.

## Want to implement it?

- [ ] I can contribute the implementation
- [ ] I am suggesting the idea for someone else to pick up
